add_definitions(-D__WINESRC__)
spec2def(wtsapi32.dll wtsapi32.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# wtsapi32.dll is all Rust (wtsapi32-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wtsapi32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# wtsapi32.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wtsapi32-rust/src/wtsapi32/wtsapi32.rs)
add_cargo_module(wtsapi32 wtsapi32-cargo wtsapi32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE wtsapi32-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle
